rationale: The cosine LR schedule uses total_steps_estimate=3000, but the model actually runs ~12000+ steps (30+ epochs × 397 batches/epoch). Clamping progress to [0,1] and setting total_steps_estimate to ~12000 will give a smooth, monotonic decay over the full training period.
